nodes.name: Webhook: PDF Invoice Upload
nodes.notes: Real binary PDF upload. The multipart file field must be named "data" (not "invoiceFile" like Flow 1a's upload demo) -- this deliberately matches the unmodified "fix base64" node's hardcoded binaryPropertyName so the reused OCR chain needs zero changes. Imported inactive per the Flow 1b task: activate only after selecting real Gemini credentials in the n8n UI.

nodes.name: fix base64
nodes.notes: REUSED VERBATIM from examples/n8n/digitax_invoice_intake.json (same node id/parameters). Do not modify the extraction logic here -- see the workflow-level note on why binaryPropertyName stays "data".

nodes.name: Build Gemini Request
nodes.notes: REUSED VERBATIM from digitax_invoice_intake.json. The embedded prompt hint ("expected buyer company is Unternehmen X", specific addresses/VAT ID) is hardcoded to that one organization -- a known limitation when Flow 1b is used for a different organizationId (e.g. unternehmen-y-demo). The downstream ORG-001 comparison is still evaluated against whichever organization was actually selected, so a wrong hint degrades extraction guidance quality, not control correctness. Not fixed here per the task's explicit instruction to reuse this node's logic unmodified; documented in the README instead.

nodes.name: File-Based OCR with Gemini 2.5
nodes.notes: REUSED VERBATIM from digitax_invoice_intake.json, including its existing retryOnFail/maxTries:5/onError:continueErrorOutput. Credential is the same REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_CREDENTIAL_ID placeholder as the historical workflow -- select a real Google Gemini (PaLM) API credential in the n8n UI before activating; nothing is copied from any other n8n instance.

nodes.name: Gemini Output Parser
nodes.notes: jsCode REUSED VERBATIM from digitax_invoice_intake.json (same parsing/normalization logic, same node id). The ONLY addition versus the historical node is onError: "continueErrorOutput" -- this node throws on malformed Gemini output by design (invalid JSON, unexpected response shape), and the historical mailbox-intake workflow had no fail-safe wrapping around that. This workflow must never end as an unhandled execution error, so the thrown error is now routed to a proper nicht_pruefbar/technical_review payload instead of crashing the run. This is error-handling wiring only; the parsing logic itself is untouched.

nodes.name: Human Review - Prioritized
nodes.notes: Phase 1b ends here: routed for prioritized human review (klaerung_erforderlich, or a nicht_pruefbar not_reliable-extraction outcome from ORG-001 itself). No automated approval, booking, payment, or supplier communication.

nodes.name: Human Review - Technical
nodes.notes: Explicit technical-failure route -- does not depend on the unknown-value fallback. Reached for missing upload, unknown organization profile, OCR service failure, or OCR output parse failure. No automated approval, booking, payment, or supplier communication.

nodes.name: Human Review - Unknown (fallback)
nodes.notes: Safety fallback for a routing value that matches none of the explicit routes above -- never silently ignored.
